blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Leading the direct examination of witness lawyer Karen Batu, officer in charge of the Records Division of the Office of the Ombudsman, Tuesday, September 15, is lawyer James Bryan Ibrahim Alih. Alih is a senior associate of the Pecabar law and is among the private lawyers who volunteered to assist the House prosecution panel pro-bono in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. He specializes in criminal and civil litigation and handles complex cases involving fraud, graft and corruption.
